name: OJapp PWA Marketing
author: ojach

sections.description:
One Page. One App.

OJapp PWA Marketing lets visitors add individual posts, pages, and WooCommerce products to their Home Screen with a unique icon for each page.

Instead of turning your entire website into a single PWA, OJapp PWA Marketing generates a dedicated manifest.json for each page.

This means your content can live on the Home Screen individually — one article, one product, one page, one icon.

Perfect for:

  • Blogs
  • WooCommerce stores
  • Landing pages
  • Documentation
  • Product catalogs

See It in Action

OJapp Tips uses OJapp PWA Marketing.

Open any article on OJapp Tips and add it to your Home Screen to see how each article appears with its own dedicated icon.

Demo:
https://tips.ojapp.app/ojapp-pwa-marketing-demo2/

Free Features

  • Dynamic manifest.json for each page
  • Page-specific Home Screen icons
  • start_url set to “.”
  • Automatic icon generation from featured images
  • Automatic apple-touch-icon support
  • Custom icon for each post, page, or product
  • Custom Home Screen name
  • WooCommerce support
  • Lightweight and no external services

OJapp PWA Marketing PRO

PRO adds advanced features for Home Screen Marketing, including:

  • Home Screen launch analytics
  • OS-based analytics
  • Custom icon overlays
  • Advanced icon customization
  • Additional manifest settings

Learn more about PRO:
https://ojapp.app/pwa-marketing/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin.
  2. Activate it.
  3. Open a supported post or page.
  4. Add it to the home screen.
sections.faq:
Does this create a traditional PWA?

No.

This plugin focuses on page-specific home screen experiences instead of creating a single installable application.

Does it support WooCommerce?

Yes.

Products can generate their own manifest and home screen icon automatically.

Does it work without WooCommerce?

Yes.

It supports standard WordPress posts and pages out of the box.
